title: What The Gamelan Knows — EN/ID/JA (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Indonesian Japanese philosophy language learning bronze
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The gamelan is not one instrument — it's thirty instruments being one
An Indonesian bronze percussion orchestra done
Gongs and metallophones and drums arranged in layers
The gamelan doesn't have a conductor — it doesn't need one of those players

[Verse 2 — Indonesian, with English translation]
Gamelan tahu apa yang tidak kita ketahui
[The gamelan knows what we do not know]
Tiga puluh instrumen bermain seperti satu hati
[Thirty instruments play like one heart]
Tidak ada konduktor karena musik tahu jalannya sendiri
[There is no conductor because the music knows its own path]
Gamelan mengajarkan kita tentang harmoni
[The gamelan teaches us about harmony]

[Chorus — English]
What does the gamelan know that I don't know?
It knows that thirty instruments agreeing is no small show
What does the gamelan know in the temple hour?
It knows the difference between music and a prayer with power
That's my boy

[Bridge — Japanese, with English translation]
ガムランは三十の楽器が一つになる奇跡
[The gamelan is the miracle of thirty instruments becoming one]
インドネシアの銅が、祈りの音を奏でる
[Indonesian bronze plays the sound of prayer]
指揮者がいなくても、音楽は完全だ
[Even without a conductor, the music is complete]
ガムランが知っていることを、西洋はまだ学んでいる
[What the gamelan knows, the West is still learning]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the gamelan knows… Apa yang diketahui gamelan… ガムランが知ること
Thirty becoming one — Tiga puluh menjadi satu — 三十が一つになる
That's my boy
